gaps.sentence: The thief was sent to ___ prison for three years.
gaps.explanation: 'Sent to prison' — the institution, no article; 'the prison' would mean the building.

gaps.sentence: He earns fifty thousand pounds ___ year.
gaps.explanation: 'Fifty thousand a year' — 'a' = per in rates.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ only person to solve the puzzle.
gaps.explanation: 'The only person' — 'only' makes the noun unique, so 'the'.

gaps.sentence: He considers himself ___ expert on medieval art.
gaps.explanation: 'An expert' — 'expert' starts with a vowel sound.
'Inflation' as a general economic concept takes no article.

gaps.sentence: ___ noise woke me up in the middle of the night.
gaps.explanation: 'The noise' — the one that woke me; 'in the night' is a fixed phrase.

gaps.sentence: My uncle is ___ university lecturer and a painter in his free time.
gaps.explanation: 'A university lecturer' (the u sounds like /juː/); the second gap is also 'an artist'.

gaps.sentence: We reached ___ agreement after hours of negotiation.
gaps.explanation: 'Reach an agreement' — 'agreement' starts with a vowel sound.
